name: school_interior_studentdesk
description: An intimate corner of a cozy Greek classroom in isometric view, featuring exactly one wooden student desk and one chair placed directly behind it facing the viewer.

color_palette: Soft blue (#ADD8E6) covers the walls to create a calm classroom backdrop.
Warm yellow (#FFD700) accents the desk edges and trim to add cheerful focus.
Honey oak brown (#C68642) finishes the single desk and chair, with subtle rich green accents (#228B22) in simple painted motifs.
visual_style.architectural_style: Simple, clean lines typical of a traditional Greek village schoolhouse, with whitewashed stucco walls lightly tinted soft blue and exposed wooden beams. The composition centers on a single study spot framed in a neat isometric view near a large window.
visual_style.furniture: Exactly one honey-oak wooden student desk and one matching chair with warm yellow accents are set at a three-quarter isometric angle; the chair is directly behind the desk so a seated student faces the viewer. No other furniture is present.
materials: Whitewashed stucco walls with exposed wooden beam accents
Light gray stone floor with a smooth, worn texture
Honey oak wood for the single desk and chair with hand-painted yellow and green details
Blue-and-white ceramic trim for subtle Mediterranean detailing
